description: This file defines a React functional component named Topbar, which serves as a header/navigation bar for a web application. It manages user authentication status, wallet connection via the Phantom Solana wallet, and provides UI elements like links and buttons for logout and wallet connection.

methods.name: Topbar
methods.description: React functional component that renders the application's top navigation bar, including wallet connection and user info.

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Asynchronous function to connect to Phantom wallet and set wallet address.

methods.name: short
methods.description: Utility function to abbreviate wallet address for display.
